[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Fri 19:17): Linke ohne Emde | Gewalt an Kleistschule | Tabaksteuer
item.description:
Originally published Fri 16 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
In Berlin haben Linke, Grüne und SPD ihre Sondierungsgespräche fortgesetzt. Parallel dazu ist die Linke auf Abstand von der umstrittenen Abgeordneten Emke gegangen. Außerdem: Gewaltvorfälle an Kleistschule in FFO; Berliner Reaktionen auf Tabaksteuer; Blücherplatz in Eva-Mamlok-Platz umbenannt. "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sat 06:31): Trump fires press secretary Katie Zacharia
item.description:
Originally published Sat 17 Oct 2026 06:31 IDT.

The White House press secretary Katie Zacharia has been ousted after just five days, amid criticism of her first media briefing and questions about her legal background. Also: figures released by the Brazilian government indicate that deforestation in the Amazon has hit record lows. Police in the US state of Oregon have described how a teacher and a school parent fought off the gunman who killed four people at a primary school on Thursday. Ukraine says a counteroffensive has liberated more than 270 sq km of occupied land from Russian troops - we have a special report from the frontline. More than 120 people have been arrested during clashes with police in the Albanian capital, Tirana. An investigation into fraud involving penile implant surgeries has been launched in Sicily, and should car radios be a legal requirement?

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
